levels.surface: محمد بن الحسين بن زيد الزيات

notes: «حدثنا أبي رضي الله عنه» : «أبي» is a bare relation, the compiler's father, not named
«قالا» joins Muhammad b. Yahya and Ahmad b. Idris in one level
the Imam is named in the words after the chain («كان أمير المؤمنين عليه السلام يقول»), so he is the last link, kind imam_in_text; the saying is a list of maxims with no further link
